posts.text:
Tuesday, Nov 10: Toronto's streetcars lost 962 hours to delays, across all routes.

Slowest for its length: 511 Bathurst northbound. A typical 4.8 km trip lost 11 min (usually 11).
Smoothest: 507 Long Branch eastbound, 12 min over 7.8 km (usually 11).

#TTC #TransitSky #DataViz

https://stuckin.to/

Tuesday's slowest spot: Southbound on York St, approaching Adelaide St West.
The average streetcar lost 2 min 20 s here (usually 1 min 33 s). Across 133 trips, that adds up to 5.2 hours.
This signal has no transit priority.
posts.alt: 3D map of York St around Adelaide St West, rotated to Toronto's street grid. Delay is drawn as a coloured ridge above the track, rising where streetcars lose time; the southbound stretch at Adelaide St West is highlighted, peaking at about 2 min 20 s lost per streetcar.

shot.title: York St southbound, approaching Adelaide St West
shot.sub: Tuesday, Nov 10: 2 min 20 s lost per streetcar · 133 trips

posts.text:
Most short-turned, Tuesday, Nov 10: 505 Dundas. 1 in 15 trips (31) were sent back before the end of the line, most after Dundas St West at Lansdowne Ave (westbound, 24), instead of going on to Dundas West Station.

Across all routes, 4% of trips were short-turned.
posts.alt: Map of the 505 Dundas route in the waits view: a column at each stop, taller and darker where riders waited longer than scheduled, and yellow warning signs where cars were short-turned. A tooltip on the busiest spot, after Dundas St West at Lansdowne Ave, gives how many westbound cars were sent back there instead of going on to Dundas West Station.

posts.text:
Most held at a signal, Tuesday, Nov 10: eastbound at Fort York Blvd & Fleet St.

36% of streetcars waited 90 s or more beyond a clean approach, about a full signal cycle, despite transit priority.
About 299 streetcars came through.
posts.alt: Map of the streets around Fort York Blvd & Fleet St, with arrows for each direction of streetcar travel into each signal, coloured by how often streetcars were held 90 seconds or more. A tooltip for the eastbound approach reads 36% held 90 s+, with a histogram of extra time through the approach.

posts.text:
Tuesday, Nov 10: at the busiest moment (5:20 pm), 148 streetcars were in service, against 151 scheduled.
Overall, 99% of scheduled streetcar service ran, and buses ran 1,024 hours on streetcar routes.
Furthest behind: 505 Dundas, at 88% of its scheduled service.
posts.alt: Line chart of streetcars in service through Tuesday, Nov 10, every 10 minutes from 4 am, against the TTC's schedule (dashed). The busiest moment was 148 streetcars at 5:20 pm, against 151 scheduled; over the day 99% of scheduled streetcar hours ran.

posts.text:
Longest extra wait at a stop, Tuesday, Nov 10: Dundas St West at Bay St (505 Dundas westbound).

Riders waited 7.9 min on average, against 3.0 if cars had come as scheduled: 4.8 min extra. 1 in 5 cars came bunched, and 57 of 230 scheduled cars never came.
posts.alt: Map of the streets around Dundas St West at Bay St in the waits view, a column at each stop. A tooltip for the stop reads 4.8 minutes of excess wait, with how often cars came bunched or with gaps, and a chart of the spread of gaps between cars.
